decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the firm's coolant management systems and supports high-pressure machining demand, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The nozzle line is a low-cost accessory range that complements pumps and boosters, though the drop of the centrifuge shows the firm does prune its coolant portfolio.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying business for metalworking customers.
Magnetic belt chip conveyors fill a standard niche in a complete chip conveyor portfolio that customers expect.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are among the most widely used conveyor types and central to the firm's established offer.
